title.zh: FCA opens crypto authorization window ahead of 2027 UK regime
title.en: FCA opens crypto authorization window ahead of 2027 UK regime

current_state.zh: The UK's FCA opened its crypto authorization application window with a Feb. 28, 2027 deadline ahead of a regime taking effect Oct. 25, 2027, requiring firms to obtain new authorization rather than relying on existing money laundering registrations.
current_state.en: The UK's FCA opened its crypto authorization application window with a Feb. 28, 2027 deadline ahead of a regime taking effect Oct. 25, 2027, requiring firms to obtain new authorization rather than relying on existing money laundering registrations.
